name: Sticky Notes
summary: Quick notes in the menu bar, and a window to write and sort them.
description: Press Option+Shift+N to start a note from anywhere. Your newest notes are a click away in the menu bar, and the Sticky Notes window holds all of them: colours, pinning, search and checklists. Notes are kept on your computer, so they are there on every device you open it from.

settings.label: Show the number of notes in the menu bar

actions.label: New Sticky Note
actions.detail: Starts a note in Sticky Notes
